uwp_capture_status: partial: uwp-app-runner returned ok:true (process alive, window present) but the original UWP app hung on the SDK sample 'Universal Windows Platform sample' extended-splash screen across two fresh launches (20s settle). MainPage never presented; the CoreWindow content pane stayed empty in the UIA tree, so the golden frames (parity/baseline/screenshots/*.png) show only the splash and no feature-level controls were exposed or actuable. No live UWP behavioral baseline was obtainable; the source-derived checklist (Extract-UwpFeatureChecklist) is the structural ground truth used instead.

features.name: Scenario 1 - Data Events
features.description: Registers an event listener for altimeter data and displays the change in height in meters as reports arrive. Enable begins the subscription; Disable ends it. Status area reports sensor availability.
expected_behaviour: Scenario list shows '1) Data Events' and it is selectable/navigable
Description text 'Registers an event listener for altimeter data and displays the change in height in meters as they are reported.' is shown
Enable and Disable buttons are present; Disable is disabled until Enable is pressed
'Altitude change(m):' output field shows 'No data' before any reading
When no altimeter is present the Status area shows 'No altimeter found' (defensive fallback), not a blank/crash

features.name: Scenario 2 - Polling
features.description: Polls for altimeter data on demand and displays the change in height in meters. Get Data performs a single reading.
expected_behaviour: Scenario list shows '2) Polling' and it is selectable/navigable
Description text 'Polls for altimeter data and displays the change in height in meters.' is shown
Get Data button is present and invokable
'Altitude change(m):' output field shows 'No data' before any reading
When no altimeter is present the Status area shows 'No altimeter found' (defensive fallback), not a blank/crash
